src/domains/nzb.ts.name: Usenet download mock
src/domains/nzb.ts.description: Lists pretend Usenet downloaders and runs NZB jobs that can be added, controlled, listed and read from.

src/domains/soulseek.ts.name: Soulseek mock
src/domains/soulseek.ts.description: Simulates Soulseek searches, browsing and downloads with pause, resume, cancel, read, save and release.

src/domains/torrent-fixtures.ts.name: Download sample bytes
src/domains/torrent-fixtures.ts.description: Shared download helpers: repeatable image bytes, minimal .torrent files and the torrent capability snapshot, used by torrent, NZB and Soulseek.

src/domains/torrent.ts.name: Torrent download mock
src/domains/torrent.ts.description: Runs pretend torrent jobs for catalog images: add, status, pause, resume, remove, file selection, reads, metadata and saving.

src/domains/webrtc.ts.name: Peer connection mock
src/domains/webrtc.ts.description: Pairs pretend peer-to-peer sessions between windows by direct identity or shared room, or gives a lone session an echoing stand-in peer, and pushes state, peer, message and closed events.
